QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_43

question.text: When did SEBI mandate that market infrastructure institutions (MIIs) must use uniform transaction charges, eliminating volume-based slab discounts?

explanation.text: The Logic: In July 2024, SEBI mandated MIIs to use uniform transaction charges, eliminating volume-based slab discounts for brokers. This was done to increase transparency for end investors. The Trap: Previously, high-volume brokers got slab discounts on exchange charges, which were not always passed on to clients. Uniform charges ensure all clients pay the same rate regardless of their broker's volume. Note: The workbook records the SEBI mandate month as July 2024 but does not specify a separate effective-from date.
